items.headline: Oracle force majeure notice on New Mexico data center puts loan and lease documents under scrutiny
items.note: A force majeure notice on the Oracle-leased Project Jupiter site raises lease-payment and covenant risk for the roughly $18B of project-finance loans backing it.

items.headline: Oracle-linked $18B New Mexico data center loans quoted at 89-91 cents as placement stalls
items.note: Syndicate banks struggling to place the debt with a wider investor base, amid permitting and litigation delays, is a stressed-syndication signal for Stargate-type financings.

items.headline: CoreWeave plans $3B convertible debt offering; stock falls nearly 5%
items.note: CoreWeave's continued reliance on new debt to fund $31-35B of 2026 capex, after earlier junk-rated facilities and CDS near 855bp, keeps neocloud refinancing risk in focus.
